user.title: Connect to your ArtiLED Hub
user.description: Enter the Hub's IP address or hostname and its API token (Hub web UI → Settings → API).

reauth_confirm.title: ArtiLED Hub token no longer works
reauth_confirm.description: The Hub at {host} rejected the stored API token. Enter the current token (Hub web UI → Settings → API). Your rooms, zones, names and voice settings are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Hub. Check the host and network.
error.invalid_auth: The Hub rejected the API token.

abort.reauth_failed: That configuration entry no longer exists.
abort.wrong_hub: That token belongs to a different ArtiLED Hub. Use the token for the Hub already configured here, or add the other Hub as a new integration.
